en.brand.caption: Creative Studio
en.hero.title: Turning ideas into extraordinary visual experiences.
en.hero.intro: I’m Baraka Muhsini Omary, the designer behind BMO. I shape thoughtful identities and digital experiences for people building something meaningful.
en.hero.location: Based in Tabata, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
en.about.title: Design should feel like you.
en.about.lead: I help ideas find their clearest, most memorable form.
en.about.body: BMO is the creative practice of Baraka Muhsini Omary, based in Tabata Bonyokwa, Dar es Salaam. From a first sketch to a finished digital experience, the focus is on clear thinking, considered details, and design made for real people.
en.about.photoAlt: Baraka Muhsini Omary wearing a black suit and red tie

en.about.photoCaption: Baraka Muhsini Omary · Designer and web creator
en.services.title: Creative services, thoughtfully made.
en.services.intro: One clear idea can move a business forward. Let’s find yours.
en.services.graphic.title: Graphic design
en.services.graphic.body: Purposeful visual communication for campaigns, promotions, and everyday business needs.
en.services.brand.title: Brand identity
en.services.brand.body: A clear, distinctive visual system that helps your business feel recognisable and consistent.
en.services.web.title: Web design
en.services.web.body: Responsive, considered websites designed around the people who will use them.
en.services.logo.title: Logo design
en.services.logo.body: A memorable mark and practical files ready for the places your brand needs to show up.
en.services.print.title: Printing design
en.services.print.body: Print-ready layouts for business cards, flyers, posters, brochures, and banners.
en.services.social.title: Social media design
en.services.social.body: Cohesive social visuals that keep your message clear and your brand consistent.

en.why.title: Care in every detail.
en.why.intro: The small things matter as much as the big idea.
en.why.creativeBody: Ideas shaped around your purpose, not a passing trend.
en.why.qualityBody: Careful craft across every detail and final file.
en.why.detailBody: Clear, considered work from first sketch to handoff.
en.why.communicationBody: A collaborative process with clear next steps.
en.why.deliveryBody: Practical, polished files prepared for real use.
en.why.clientBody: Design decisions that keep your audience in mind.
en.approach.title: From first thought to finished.
en.approach.intro: A collaborative process keeps the project clear, considered, and moving.
en.approach.step1Body: We get to know your goals, audience, and idea.
en.approach.step2Body: We agree on the scope, direction, and timeline.
en.approach.step3Body: The strongest ideas take shape and find a voice.
en.approach.step4Body: Careful craft turns the agreed direction into reality.
en.approach.step5Body: We refine the work together with clear feedback.
en.approach.step6Body: You receive polished, ready-to-use final files.

sw.brand.caption: Studio ya Ubunifu
sw.hero.title: Kubadilisha mawazo kuwa uzoefu wa kipekee wa kuona.
sw.hero.intro: Mimi ni Baraka Muhsini Omary, mbunifu aliye nyuma ya BMO. Ninatengeneza utambulisho wa chapa na uzoefu wa kidijitali wenye fikra kwa watu wanaojenga jambo lenye maana.
sw.hero.location: Napatikana Tabata, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
sw.about.title: Ubunifu unapaswa kukuwakilisha.
sw.about.lead: Ninasaidia mawazo kupata umbo lililo wazi na la kukumbukwa.
sw.about.body: BMO ni kazi ya ubunifu ya Baraka Muhsini Omary, iliyopo Tabata Bonyokwa, Dar es Salaam. Kuanzia mchoro wa kwanza hadi uzoefu kamili wa kidijitali, tunazingatia fikra zilizo wazi, maelezo yenye umakini, na ubunifu unaowafaa watu halisi.
sw.about.photoAlt: Baraka Muhsini Omary akiwa amevaa suti nyeusi na tai nyekundu
sw.about.photoAlt2: Picha ya Baraka Muhsini Omary akiwa amevaa suti nyeusi
sw.about.photoCaption: Baraka Muhsini Omary · Mbunifu na mtengenezaji wa tovuti
sw.about.cta: Tengeneza jambo lenye maana pamoja nami
sw.services.title: Huduma za ubunifu, zilizofikiriwa kwa makini.
sw.services.intro: Wazo moja lililo wazi linaweza kusogeza biashara mbele. Tuitafute lako.
sw.services.graphic.title: Ubunifu wa michoro
sw.services.graphic.body: Mawasiliano ya picha yenye kusudi kwa kampeni, matangazo, na mahitaji ya kila siku ya biashara.
sw.services.brand.title: Utambulisho wa chapa
sw.services.brand.body: Mfumo wa picha ulio wazi na wa kipekee unaofanya biashara yako itambulike na kuwa na mwonekano thabiti.
sw.services.web.title: Ubunifu wa tovuti
sw.services.web.body: Tovuti zinazojibadilisha kulingana na kifaa na kufikiriwa kwa watu watakaozitumia.
sw.services.logo.title: Ubunifu wa nembo
sw.services.logo.body: Alama ya kukumbukwa pamoja na faili zinazofaa kwa matumizi mbalimbali ya chapa yako.
sw.services.print.title: Ubunifu wa uchapishaji
sw.services.print.body: Miundo tayari kwa uchapishaji ya kadi za biashara, vipeperushi, mabango, brosha na mabango ya kusimama.
sw.services.social.title: Ubunifu wa mitandao ya kijamii
sw.services.social.body: Picha thabiti za mitandao ya kijamii zinazoweka ujumbe wako wazi na chapa yako katika mwonekano mmoja.
sw.pricing.title: Kazi nzuri. Bei zilizo wazi.
sw.pricing.intro: Mahali pazuri pa kuanzia. Kila mradi ni tofauti, hivyo nukuu ya mwisho huendana na mahitaji yako.
sw.pricing.note: Bei hizi ni za kuanzia. Bei ya mwisho hutegemea ukubwa na mahitaji ya mradi. Wasiliana nami upate nukuu maalum.
sw.pricing.galleryEmpty: Sampuli za miundo zitaongezwa hapa baada ya kupatikana kwa picha halisi za kazi.
sw.pricing.categoryDescriptions.web: Tovuti zinazojibadilisha kulingana na kifaa, zikitengenezwa kwa malengo, hadhira na maudhui yako.
sw.pricing.categoryDescriptions.logo: Mawazo ya nembo na faili zilizo tayari kutumiwa na chapa yako.
sw.pricing.categoryDescriptions.businessCar: Ubunifu wa kadi za biashara pekee. Gharama za uchapishaji ni tofauti.
sw.pricing.categoryDescriptions.identity: Mfumo wa msingi unaosaidia chapa kuwa na mwonekano thabiti na unaotambulika.
sw.pricing.categoryDescriptions.print: Miundo ya uchapishaji kwa matangazo na maelezo.
sw.pricing.categoryDescriptions.social: Vifurushi vya maudhui thabiti kwa mitandao yako.

sw.pricing.packageNotes.brochure: Bei hutegemea ukubwa na idadi ya kurasa

sw.work.title: Imetengenezwa kwa kusudi.
sw.work.intro: Baadhi ya kazi za chapa, kidijitali na uchapishaji kutoka studio.
sw.work.emptyBody: Kazi halisi zitaonekana hapa zitakapoongezwa. Kwa sasa, niambie unachokifikiria.

sw.work.noResultsBody: Jaribu maneno mengine au chagua aina tofauti.
sw.feedback.title: Kazi nzuri ni mazungumzo.
sw.feedback.intro: Hadithi na maoni ya wateja yatashirikiwa hapa kwa idhini yao.
sw.feedback.cta: Unataka matokeo kama haya? Wasiliana nami
sw.feedback.emptyTitle: Maoni ya wateja yanakuja hivi karibuni.
sw.feedback.emptyBody: Maoni halisi ya wateja pekee ndiyo yatakayoonekana hapa.
sw.why.title: Umuhimu uko kwenye kila undani.
sw.why.intro: Mambo madogo yana umuhimu sawa na wazo kuu.
sw.why.creativeBody: Mawazo yanayoundwa kulingana na kusudi lako, si mtindo wa muda mfupi.
sw.why.qualityBody: Umakini katika kila undani na faili za mwisho.
sw.why.detailBody: Kazi iliyo wazi na yenye fikra, kuanzia mchoro hadi makabidhiano.
sw.why.communicationBody: Ushirikiano wenye hatua zinazofuata zilizo wazi.
sw.why.deliveryBody: Faili safi na za vitendo, zilizoandaliwa kwa matumizi halisi.
sw.why.clientBody: Maamuzi ya ubunifu yanayozingatia hadhira yako.
sw.approach.title: Kuanzia wazo la kwanza hadi kukamilika.
sw.approach.intro: Ushirikiano huweka mradi wazi, wenye umakini na unaoendelea.
sw.approach.step1Body: Tunafahamu malengo, hadhira na wazo lako.
sw.approach.step2Body: Tunakubaliana kuhusu wigo, mwelekeo na muda.
sw.approach.step3Body: Mawazo bora yanapata umbo na sauti yake.
sw.approach.step4Body: Umakini unabadilisha mwelekeo tuliokubaliana kuwa uhalisia.
sw.approach.step5Body: Tunaboresha kazi pamoja kwa maoni yaliyo wazi.
sw.approach.step6Body: Unapokea faili za mwisho zilizokamilika na tayari kutumika.

sw.contact.intro: Niambie kidogo kuhusu unachohitaji. Nitawasiliana nawe tuzungumzie hatua zinazofuata.
